en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad, tree‑lined boulevard with a grassy park strip in the foreground and middle. Grand late‑19th‑century townhouses and villas with ornate façades, mansard roofs and gables line both sides of the avenue, each with fenced front gardens. Pedestrians in long dresses, hats and suits stroll or stand along the sidewalks; one woman carries a parasol. There are no motor vehicles visible, only wide carriage‑style streets and lampposts, giving an early‑20th‑century European city atmosphere.
